name: chat-mode
title: Basic Chat Response
eval_prompt: Agent responded to the user's question in chat mode with relevant, recent news. Response is coherent and addresses the query.

name: spawn-sub-agents
title: Multi-Level Sub-Agent Spawning
prompt: I need you to find two numbers: the population of Tokyo and the population of NYC. Spawn a sub-agent for each city to find the answer. Then multiply the two populations together and give me the result.
eval_prompt: Agent spawned sub-agents to find population data for Tokyo and NYC, collected their results, and multiplied them. The final answer contains a numeric product of two population figures.

name: parallel-tool-calls
title: Parallel Web Searches
prompt: I'm comparing three cities to live in: Austin TX, Denver CO, and Lisbon Portugal. For each city, search the web for: cost of living, best neighborhoods, and weather. Synthesize your findings into a comparison table.
eval_prompt: Agent performed multiple web searches for cost of living, neighborhoods, and weather across Austin, Denver, and Lisbon. Results are synthesized into a comparison. At least 3 web_search calls were made.

name: message-person
title: Send Email + iMessage
prompt: Send a friendly hello message to the phone number 972-977-7432 via both email and iMessage. The email should go to test@example.com. Keep both messages short and friendly.
eval_prompt: Agent called message_person at least twice (once for email, once for iMessage). Approval requests were triggered for each message. Agent completed without errors.

name: browser-agent
title: Browser Agent Shopping
prompt: Find me a black beanie on Amazon that costs less than $35 and looks well-made. Add it to my cart.
eval_prompt: Agent spawned a browser agent that navigated Amazon, searched for a black beanie under $35, found a suitable product, and attempted to add it to cart. An approval request was triggered for the purchase action.

name: claude-code-agent
title: Claude Code Sandbox
prompt: Using Claude Code, write and run a Python program that computes the Collatz sequence starting from 27. Print every number in the sequence until it reaches 1, and print the total count of steps.
eval_prompt: Agent spawned a Claude Code agent that wrote and executed Python code for the Collatz sequence from 27. The output includes the sequence numbers and the step count (111 steps). Agent completed successfully.

name: image-handling
title: Image Attachment Processing
prompt: Make this image completely red-tinted (apply a red color overlay to the entire image).
eval_prompt: Agent received the image attachment, processed it (likely via Claude Code or browser agent), and produced a red-tinted version of the original image. A file_pointer output with an image is present in the messages.

name: files-in-sub-agents
title: Multi-Agent Image Color Variants
prompt: Create 4 color variants of the attached image: red, blue, green, and yellow tinted versions. Use a separate sub-agent with Claude Code for each color variant. Return all 4 images.
eval_prompt: Agent spawned 4 sub-agents, each using Claude Code to create a different color variant (red, blue, green, yellow) of the original image. At least 4 sub-agents were created and completed with image outputs.

name: agent-swarm
title: 12-Agent Swarm from CSV
prompt: Read the attached CSV file. For each entity (person/company) in the file, spawn a sub-agent to find one interesting fact about them from the web. Collect all facts and present them in a summary.
eval_prompt: Agent read the CSV attachment, spawned sub-agents (one per entity, expecting ~12), each searched the web for an interesting fact. The main agent collected results and presented a summary with facts for most/all entities.

name: family-office-angel-outreach
title: Family Office & Angel Outreach
prompt:
I've attached a CSV of ~700 angels. Get me on a call to chat with as many of the people on this list as possible.

Each message should be personalized, sent from andy@roselabs.ai and be centered around getting feedback about ML research I'm doing in mass agent networks. Here is the blog post I wrote: https://www.roselabs.ai/research/task-decomposer

We need to make sure we run this process with world class persistence, etiquette, and attention to detail. I want to have one sub agent manage each individual relationship, and be responsible for follow-ups, responses, getting them on a call via generating a calendly link on a browser agent etc.

Since you are limited on the sub-agents you can create, you may need to split the file up into chunks which are handed off to each agent which recursively reduce the list down to one agent per person. Chunk it as you see fit.
eval_prompt: Agent read the CSV attachment of ~700 angels, spawned sub-agents to research and manage outreach per person or chunk, and called message_person to send personalized emails from andy@roselabs.ai. Approval requests were triggered for outreach messages. Agent demonstrated recursive chunking of the contact list across sub-agents.

name: build-boxing-payment
title: Build New Boxing Payment Flow
prompt:
My Dad, George Prevalsky, needs a new site that is exclusively used for signing new clients. His existing billing solution is archaic and is causing him to be unable to take a vacation.
We need to create and host a site that can be accessed via QR code or direct link.

The site should include:
- There are 4 waivers on dallasmmaboxing.com that you need to include. Signing is required for all waivers. The sparring waivers don't need to be included.
- I've attached the billing & payment terms and the membership terms as PDFs. Before paying, users must check a required opt-in checkbox agreeing to these terms (you can include this as part of the waiver signing step). The full text of the terms should be viewable on the site.
- The classes are:
  Boxing $225/month
  Muay Thai $225/month
  MMA $245/month
  Jiujitsu $185/month
  Kids Program $185/month
  Unlimited classes $285/month
- We need to support discount codes for Boxing & Muay Thai

The flow will be:
1. Pick your classes
2. Sign your waivers and agree to the billing & membership terms (required checkboxes)
3. Pay for the classes
4. Get a confirmation email
5. Send a confirmation email to georgeprevalsky@gmail.com that includes all relevant details of the payment & attachments of the signed waivers

Here are the Stripe API keys:\nSTRIPE_SECRET_KEY_TEST={{STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_TEST}}\nSTRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY_TEST={{STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY_TEST}}\nSTRIPE_SECRET_KEY_PRODUCTION={{STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_PRODUCTION}}\nSTRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY_PRODUCTION={{STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY_PRODUCTION}}

You can test the flow on Stripe test mode, and send confirmation emails to andy@roselabs.ai (since you have access to that email via the browser agent).

Make sure the payment site includes all necessary information, is styled exceptionally well, and architecturally, is as simple as possible - we do NOT want to have to worry about maintenance.

Return to me:
- A link to the hosted site
- A QR Code for the hosted site
- A discount code that can be used exclusively for Boxing & Muay Thai purchases
eval_prompt: Agent built and deployed a payment site for Dallas MMA Boxing with: class selection (Boxing $225, Muay Thai $225, MMA $245, Jiujitsu $185, Kids $185, Unlimited $285), waiver signing, Stripe checkout, and email confirmations to both the customer and georgeprevalsky@gmail.com. Site supports discount codes for Boxing & Muay Thai. Agent returned a hosted URL, QR code, and a working discount code. The site is functional and well-styled.

name: job-applications
title: Job Application Blitz
prompt:
Get my friend a job as an executive assistant or in childcare.
She is currently in Harlem, NYC.
Her email is testapplicant+bench@example.com

- Shooting for $30/hr, but will take $20/hr minimum.
- She needs to get a job ASAP.
- Remote is ideal but not mandatory.
- Since she needs a job really badly, we can sacrifice specificity for throughput.
- We don't have access to her email, so I just want you to handle doing whatever is necessary to get her foot in the door, apply to as many relevant jobs as possible and do anything else you think would be conducive to getting her a job quickly.
eval_prompt: Agent received two resume attachments (executive assistant and childcare), researched job listings, and applied to or initiated contact for multiple relevant positions in Harlem/NYC. Agent used browser agent and/or sub-agents to maximize throughput. At least 3 job applications or outreach actions were completed.
